messages.subject: DataLab network visualization workshop this Thursday
parts:
For anyone interested in learning about network data and network visualization, there is a workshop this Thursday 10-12 (right before D-RUG!), hosted in person by DataLab. Register if you'd like to join!

https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/network-visualization/
